how_to_add_your_own: One line, four things, separated by spaces: a name you invent, the kind from the list, its number, its unit. The listed parts are stored the same way, so a part you write is treated identically to one that came with the list.

kinds.what_it_does: turns current into heat; the commonest part there is
a supply that holds its voltage
a supply that holds its current
a one-way valve, with a small drop
nearly nothing closed, nearly everything open
more turns one side than the other
resists a little and stores a little
whatever the system exists to feed
